en.name: Discovery-to-CMDB Population Coverage
en.valueProposition: Assess whether eligible observed assets are represented in ServiceNow CMDB by asset class and environment, using transparent reconciliation evidence.
en.description: Synthetic candidate product comparing generic discovery observations with ServiceNow CMDB configuration items. Observations are deduplicated to distinct assets and reconciled against CMDB representation. This example contains no actual environment data or approved metrics, thresholds, or implementation.
en.versionNotes: Public generic example only; no affiliation, deployed service or approved metric implied.

useCase.useCaseDescription: Identify eligible observed technology assets that have corresponding ServiceNow CMDB configuration items.

useCase.useCaseTitle: Assess coverage by asset class and environment
useCase.useCaseDescription: Filter eligible distinct assets by class and environment, including unresolved identities and exclusions.

description.en: Illustrative quality dimensions only. Population scope, authoritative denominator, rules and thresholds require approval.

Distinct eligible assets with confirmed qualifying CMDB representation divided by eligible distinct assets in an approved population baseline. Discovery does not automatically establish a complete population denominator.
Avoid double-counting distinct assets when multiple discovery tools report the same technology.
Measure age of discovery, CMDB and population-baseline observations against agreed freshness rules.
Independent implementations of the same metric should reconcile to a shared scope, formula, time and evidence definitions.
